Author: Nori
Name: MasterBaiter
Description:
Reads your GatherBuddy Reborn auto-gather list, works out which fishing bait and lures those fish need, and compares that against your inventory.

It shows what is missing, where to buy it and what it costs. It travels to the vendors on its own with vnavmesh and Lifestream, restocks at gil shops and scrip exchanges, plans a route across several vendors, rides to the Cosmic Exploration planets, and can fill the rest at the market board within a price per item and a total per run that you set.

Opens with /masterbaiter or the shorter /mbait.

Requires GatherBuddy Reborn, vnavmesh and Lifestream.
Punchline: Keeps your fishing bait and lures stocked, on its own.
Changelog:
0.4.0
- New: bait in your saddlebag counts towards the target instead of being bought a second time.
- New: bait with your retainers counts too, noted whenever you open one, with the name and when it was seen.
- Both are remembered in the save file and switch on and off separately under Options.
- Hovering the Have column breaks the stock down by where it is.
- A run buys what is missing, not up to the target: stock you cannot buy into must not be bought again.
- The Cosmic Exploration ride is checked like every other trip; without Bestways Burrow it is no longer offered.

0.3.10
- The Fish and Missing headings fit again: the sort arrows added in 0.3.9 needed room the columns did not have.
- The price column grows with the window again, because a scrip name is longer than any fixed width.
- A price too long for its column is shown in full when hovered.

0.3.9
- New: Preview shows every stop of a route with what it buys and what it costs, before anything moves.
- New: a search box and sortable columns above the bait table.
- Buying checks for room in your inventory instead of buying into a full bag three times.
- Cosmic Exploration prices were never shown: their currency is filed under "Other", not "Currency".
- A bait can cost different currencies at different vendors; all of them are kept, and each stop shows the one it takes.
- Scrip prices, which the game data does not carry, ship as a table read from the Eorzea Database.

0.3.8
- New: a Debug tab. The four buttons that only write to the log are out of Options.
- Options are reordered: how much to keep, what it may cost, what is listed, how it travels, and appearance last.
- Speed % sits with the other travel settings instead of between two stock amounts.
- Section headings follow the honey accent instead of staying blue.

0.3.7
- /mbait is listed in /xlhelp, where until now only the long form appeared.

0.3.6
- The Go buttons stand in one column instead of wherever the vendor text ended.
- Numbers and their headings are centred; the vertical grid lines are gone.
- The target is a number you click to edit, not twenty input boxes stacked up.
- New: a honey yellow tint for the window, under Options if you would rather not.
- The title bar names the version.

0.3.5
- Shorter walks everywhere: only 28 of 452 aetherytes had a known position, so "the nearest one" was mostly guesswork.
- Buying checks the currency first instead of trying, waiting five seconds and repeating.
- A refused teleport is retried rather than losing the whole stop.
- A bait with no listings is reported as such instead of as a failure.
- Removed the Buy missing and Buy on market board buttons; routes and Go cover it.

0.3.4
- New: "Show all fishing tackle" lists every bait and lure in the game, not just the ones your fish need.

0.3.3

0.3.2

- New: Use Sprint while travelling.

0.3.1
- Options now has "Export log to desktop" for sending diagnostics to whoever gave you this.

0.3.0
- Cosmic Exploration: rides to a planet through the Moon Rover in Mare Lamentorum and buys there.
- NPC greeting boxes are clicked through instead of being talked over.
- Buying waits for the shop to actually list its items, which fixes purchases that silently did nothing.

0.2.0
- Lures now have their own target, separate from bait.
- Scrip exchanges are supported: every category and subcategory is checked, not just the open tab.
- Vendors hidden behind a dialog menu are found, which resolves 28 more shops.
